text: **Given** an authenticated `ADMIN` **When** they request `GET /api/v1/admin/dashboard/kpis?range=month` **Then** the response contains all KPI groups with values matching the PRD definitions and `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh` period boundaries.

**Given** a non-`ADMIN` authenticated user or an unauthenticated caller **When** they call any dashboard endpoint **Then** the request is rejected with `403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN_ROLE` or `401 AUTH_SESSION_INVALID`.
**Given** `range=all_time` (invalid) **When** the KPIs endpoint is called **Then** the response is `400 ADMIN_DASHBOARD_INVALID_RANGE`.

**Given** data exists across several days **When** the charts endpoint is called for `month` **Then** the series covers the month-to-date day buckets in `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`, with zero-filled days and accurate counts.

**Given** bookings, tournaments, reports, and facilities exist **When** the recent-activities endpoint is called with `limit=10` **Then** up to 10 items are returned newest-first across the four types, with no PII.

**Given** the KPI table has many rows **When** the endpoint is queried **Then** no raw records are loaded by the service (aggregate-only) and the response includes `Cache-Control: private, max-age=30`.
**Given** a signed-in Admin **When** they use a quick navigation shortcut **Then** they are routed to the corresponding management area without any data mutation on the dashboard.
**AC-01:** Only `ADMIN` can call finance endpoints; Player and Court Owner receive `403`; unauthenticated requests receive `401`.
**AC-02:** The unified ledger returns the same amount for a top-up, payment, refund, payout, and adjustment as the owning table and the ledger entry.
**AC-03:** Admin credit/debit creates exactly one ledger entry and one audit event; an over-balance debit is rejected.
**AC-04:** Payout approve/reject/mark-paid obey the state machine; mark-paid without a transfer reference is rejected; reject releases the hold.
**AC-05:** A failed refund retry produces at most one refund credit.
**AC-06:** A completed paid booking produces exactly one `OWNER_EARNING` entry for the facility Owner; repeated sweeps do not duplicate it.
**AC-07:** Reconciliation detects each seeded discrepancy type and reports zero discrepancies in a clean fixture.
**AC-08:** Cash-flow and revenue reports return the §8.4 definitions and label revenue as an estimate.
**AC-09:** Excel export downloads a valid `.xlsx`, contains the expected sheets and rows, respects filters, and writes one audit event.
**AC-10:** Empty ranges return zero totals and empty states.
**AC-11:** No finance response or log exposes a provider secret, signature, or full bank account number.
**AC-12:** The base frontend lets an Admin exercise every P0 flow end-to-end, and all screens are marked **UI-REDO**.
review_note: Tiêu chí milestone UI-REDO, không phải hành vi nghiệp vụ kiểm chứng được.

text: **Given:** An authenticated user with the `ADMIN` role. **When:** They request the Admin report list. **Then:** The system returns `200 OK`, paginated report data, and only the approved response fields.
**Given:** An authenticated `PLAYER` or `COURT_OWNER`. **When:** They request any Admin report endpoint. **Then:** The system returns `403 Forbidden` and no report data.
**Given:** An authenticated `ADMIN`. **When:** They filter reports by `PLAYER`, `FACILITY`, or `TOURNAMENT`. **Then:** Every returned report has exactly one matching target type.

**Given:** A report with exactly one valid target. **When:** An Admin opens its detail view. **Then:** The target, reason, description, current status, and timestamps are displayed without exposing unapproved fields.
**Given:** An authenticated `ADMIN`. **When:** They request a non-existent report or submit malformed query input. **Then:** The system returns the appropriate `404` or `400` safe error response.

**Given:** An authenticated `ADMIN` and an `OPEN` report. **When:** They submit `{ "status": "RESOLVED" }` to the report status operation. **Then:** The report becomes `RESOLVED`, `resolvedAt` is recorded, and the API returns `200 OK`.

**Given:** An authenticated `ADMIN` and a `RESOLVED` report. **When:** They submit another status update. **Then:** The system rejects the transition with `400 Bad Request` and leaves the report unchanged.

**Given:** An Admin attempts an invalid report-resolution operation. **When:** The request is processed. **Then:** The system returns `400 Bad Request` with `ADMIN_REPORT_INVALID_TRANSITION` and changes neither report state nor moderation data.
**Given:** An authenticated Admin user **When:** They request `GET /api/v1/admin/users` **Then:** A paginated list of users is returned without `password_hash`.
**Given:** An authenticated Admin user **When:** They send `DELETE /api/v1/admin/users/123` **Then:** User 123's `deleted_at` field is populated in the database.
**Given:** An authenticated Player user **When:** They attempt to call `GET /api/v1/admin/users` **Then:** A `403 Forbidden` error is returned.
**Given** a Player and an eligible court with a free slot, **When** the Player creates a booking and completes payment, **Then** the booking is `CONFIRMED` immediately without any owner approval.

**Given** two Players attempt to book the same court interval concurrently, **When** both requests are processed, **Then** exactly one booking is created and the other receives `409 BOOKING_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE`.
**Given** a `PENDING_PAYMENT` booking, **When** `BOOKING_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` elapses without payment, **Then** the booking becomes `EXPIRED`, the slot is released, and the Player is notified.
**Given** an expired booking, **When** a valid VNPAY success callback arrives late, **Then** the booking is never reopened and the payment enters the refund flow.
**Given** a `CONFIRMED` paid booking before `start_time`, **When** the owner Player cancels it, **Then** the booking becomes `CANCELLED` and a full refund is triggered once.

**Given** an unpaid `PENDING_PAYMENT` booking before `start_time`, **When** the owner Player cancels it, **Then** the booking becomes `CANCELLED`, the slot is released immediately, and no refund is triggered.
**Given** a booking after `start_time`, **When** the Player attempts to cancel, **Then** the request is rejected with `409 BOOKING_CANCELLATION_DEADLINE_PASSED`.
**Given** a Player not owning a booking, **When** they request its detail or cancel it, **Then** the request is denied (`403`/`404`) without leaking existence.

**Given** a court with no `COURT_PRICINGS` covering part of opening hours, **When** availability is requested, **Then** only priced intervals are offered. Verification: unit/integration/API tests per §16; migration check for the exclusion constraint; manual concurrency check.
**Given** an authenticated `COURT_OWNER` **When** they call `GET /api/v1/owner/facilities` **Then** only facilities with `owner_id = req.user.id` are returned, paginated with `meta`.
**Given** a `COURT_OWNER` **When** they create a facility or court **Then** it is stored as `PENDING_APPROVAL` and is not bookable until Admin approval.
**Given** a facility owned by another Owner **When** the caller requests or edits it **Then** the request is rejected without revealing the resource (`404 OWNER_FACILITY_NOT_FOUND`).

**Given** an owned court with an existing pricing interval **When** the Owner submits a new interval that overlaps it **Then** the request is rejected with `409 PRICING_INTERVAL_OVERLAP` and no row is written.
**Given** an owned court with an active booking for a slot **When** the Owner blocks a range overlapping that booking **Then** the request is rejected with `409 SLOT_BLOCK_OVERLAP_ACTIVE_BOOKING`.

**Given** an owned court with no active booking **When** the Owner blocks a valid range with a reason **Then** a `COURT_SLOT_BLOCKS` row is created with status `ACTIVE`, and Player availability excludes that range.
**Given** a valid active block **When** the Owner unblocks it **Then** the block becomes `RELEASED`; bookability still requires all other availability gates.

**Given** a `CONFIRMED` booking before `start_time` on an owned court and `OWNER_CAN_CANCEL_BOOKING = true` **When** the Owner cancels with a reason **Then** the booking becomes `CANCELLED`, exactly one refund is initiated (`refundStatus = PENDING`), and one in-app notification is inserted for the Player.
**Given** an unpaid `PENDING_PAYMENT` hold on an owned court **When** the Owner cancels it **Then** it becomes `CANCELLED`, the slot is released, and `refundStatus = NONE`.
**Given** a booking already `CANCELLED` **When** the Owner cancels again **Then** the response is idempotent `200` and no second refund is initiated.
**Given** a booking on a court not owned by the caller **When** the caller cancels it **Then** the request is rejected with `404 OWNER_BOOKING_NOT_FOUND` (non-enumerating).

**Given** two concurrent requests — a Player booking and an Owner block on the same court/date/range **When** both run **Then** exactly one succeeds and the other is rejected with the appropriate overlap error.

**Given** a Player with an `OPEN` request, **When** they invite a specific eligible Player, **Then** a `PENDING` invitation exists with `expires_at` equal to the earlier of the invitation timeout and the request deadline.
**Given** a full group (owner + accepted invitees), **When** the last invitee accepts, **Then** exactly one Match in `PENDING_COURT` is created and the request becomes `MATCHED`.

text: **Given** an `OPEN` request past `expires_at`, **When** the scheduler ticks, **Then** the request becomes `EXPIRED`, pending invitations close, and accepted invitees are released with a notification.
**Given** a `PENDING` invitation past its own deadline, **When** the scheduler ticks, **Then** the invitation becomes `EXPIRED` and the request stays `OPEN`.
**Given** a `PENDING_COURT` Match, **When** the owner links a paid booking, **Then** `court_id`/`booking_id`/`scheduled_at` are set and the Match becomes `CONFIRMED`.
**Given** a Match before `scheduled_at`, **When** a Player leaves, **Then** the Match is `CANCELLED` and remaining Players must create new requests.
**Given** a Match after it starts, **When** a Player attempts the normal leave flow, **Then** the request is rejected with `409 MATCH_ALREADY_STARTED`.

**Given** a `CONFIRMED` Match, **When** `scheduled_at` and then the configured duration elapse, **Then** the Match becomes `IN_PROGRESS` and then `COMPLETED` without result recording. Verification: unit/integration/API tests per §16; migration check for the new columns and dropped objects; manual concurrency check for group formation.

text: **Given** two members sending simultaneously **When** a third member syncs **Then** both messages arrive with consecutive `seq` in commit order.
**Given** a member who left the group (`LEFT`) **When** they request history or an attachment **Then** `404`.
**Given** a Player blocked by the counterpart **When** sending a direct message **Then** `409 MESSAGING_ACTION_NOT_AVAILABLE` and no block is revealed.

**Given** a standalone group conversation **When** created via `POST /conversations/group` **Then** members can exchange messages in real time over WebSocket long-term without a 24-hour read-only lock.
**Given** a resend with the same `clientMessageId` and content **Then** one message exists and quota is unchanged.

**Given** an open WebSocket connection **When** the user signs out, the session expires, or an Admin suspends the account **Then** the WebSocket connection is closed (`1008`) and receives no further events.

**Given** two Players who have blocked each other but are both `ACTIVE` members of a `GROUP` conversation **When** either sends a group message **Then** both receive `message.created` over WebSocket and via REST `GET /messages`, while `DIRECT` messages and direct `presence.updated` between them remain blocked.

**Given** no account (active or soft-deleted) uses email E, in any letter case **When** a visitor registers as a Player with email E, a password satisfying the password policy, a full name, and a valid skill-level value **Then** a new account is created with role `PLAYER` and status `ACTIVE`, and signing in with E (in any letter case) and that password succeeds.

**Given** an account, active or soft-deleted, already uses an email that differs from E only by letter case **When** a visitor attempts to register with E **Then** registration is refused and no additional account is created.

**Given** a visitor on the registration page **When** they submit a password shorter than 8 characters, longer than 64 characters, or equal to the submitted email **Then** no account is created and the visitor sees that the password does not meet the policy.
**Given** a visitor on the registration page **When** they submit a missing or malformed email address **Then** no account is created and a validation message is shown for the email field.

**Given** the public registration flow **When** a visitor submits registration input that requests role `COURT_OWNER` or `ADMIN` by any means, including manipulated input **Then** no account with that role is created; at most a `PLAYER` account may be created from the remaining valid fields, or the request is refused entirely.

**Given** a visitor on the registration page **When** they submit a skill-level value that is not one of the six codes in `docs/business-rules-config-matrix.md` §1.2 (`BEGINNER`, `WEAK`, `AVERAGE_MINUS`, `AVERAGE`, `AVERAGE_PLUS`, `GOOD`) *(superseded by the extension survey; seven levels since 2026-11-15)* **Then** no account is created and the visitor sees that the skill level is invalid.
review_note: Danh mục 6 mã cũ được thay bằng khảo sát 16 câu và 7 bậc (2026-11-15).

text: **Given** a visitor submits valid registration input with skill-level code `AVERAGE` **When** the account is created **Then** the Player's profile skill level is `AVERAGE` (rank 4), matching `docs/business-rules-config-matrix.md` §1.2.
review_note: Đăng ký không còn nhận trực tiếp mã trình độ; trình độ do khảo sát sinh ra.

text: **Given** an Admin creates a Court Owner account with an initial password **When** the Court Owner signs in with that initial password for the first time **Then** they are required to set a new password before reaching any other page or action, and cannot bypass this step.
**Given** a Court Owner who has completed the forced password change **When** they sign in again with the new password **Then** sign-in succeeds without a forced-change step.

**Given** an `ACTIVE`, non-locked, non-soft-deleted account with email E and password P **When** the user signs in with E (in any letter case) and P **Then** sign-in succeeds and the user can use the business areas permitted for the account's role (§7.8).

**Given** an `ACTIVE` account with email E **When** someone signs in with E and a password that is not the account's password **Then** sign-in fails with the message "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng", no session is created, and restricted areas remain inaccessible.

**Given** no account uses email E **When** someone signs in with E and any password **Then** sign-in fails with the identical message "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng", no session is created, and restricted areas remain inaccessible.

**Given** an account with status `SUSPENDED` or `DEACTIVATED` **When** the user signs in with the correct email and password **Then** sign-in is refused, no session is created, and a distinct "account restricted, contact support" message is shown (no reason disclosed).

**Given** a soft-deleted account **When** the user signs in with the correct email and password **Then** sign-in is refused with the same generic message as incorrect credentials, no session is created.

**Given** an account with 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts **When** a 6th sign-in attempt is made, even with the correct password **Then** sign-in is refused and the user is told the account is temporarily locked.
**Given** a locked account **When** 15 minutes elapse and the user signs in with the correct password **Then** sign-in succeeds.

**Given** an account with one failed sign-in attempt **When** the user then signs in successfully **Then** a subsequent single failed attempt does not lock the account (the failure counter reset to zero on success).

**Given** an `ACTIVE` account whose password was P1 and for which an Admin then set a new password P2 **When** the user signs in with P1, and separately with P2 **Then** sign-in with P1 fails and sign-in with P2 succeeds, immediately requiring a password change (§15.2 pattern).
**Given** an account that an Admin changed from `SUSPENDED` back to `ACTIVE` **When** the user signs in with the correct email and current password **Then** sign-in succeeds.

**Given** an account locked after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts, and an Admin sets a new password P2 before the lock expires **When** the user signs in with P2 **Then** sign-in succeeds immediately and requires a password change.

**Given** a signed-in Player or Court Owner whose session is within 7 days of idle time and 30 days of absolute duration **When** they reload the page or navigate to another area permitted for their role **Then** they are not asked to enter credentials again.
**Given** a signed-in Admin whose session has been idle for more than 1 hour, or open for more than 8 hours **When** they attempt any authenticated action **Then** they are asked to sign in again.
**Given** a signed-in user **When** they sign out and then attempt a restricted action on the same device **Then** the action is not performed and they are asked to sign in.
**Given** the same account signed in on two devices **When** the user signs out on one device **Then** the session on the other device remains active.

**Given** a signed-in user with an active session **When** an Admin changes that account's status to `SUSPENDED`, `DEACTIVATED`, or soft-deletes it **Then** the very next authenticated action by that user is refused.

**Given** a signed-in user with one or more active sessions **When** an Admin sets a new password for that user's account **Then** every existing session for that account ends immediately, and the next sign-in requires the new password and a forced password change.
**Given** a signed-in user **When** they submit their correct current password and a new password meeting the policy **Then** the password is updated and subsequent sign-ins require the new password.
**Given** a signed-in user **When** they submit an incorrect current password **Then** the password is not changed.
**Given** an existing account **When** any actor attempts to change its system role **Then** the role is unchanged; no capability exists to perform this change in MVP.

**Given** a person who registered a Player account and was separately given a Court Owner account by an Admin, using two different emails **When** they sign in to the Court Owner account **Then** they cannot access Player-only business areas (matchmaking, booking as a booker, tournament participation or creation) from that account.

**Given** an unauthenticated visitor **When** they attempt an action that requires sign-in, such as creating a court booking **Then** the action is not performed, restricted content is not shown, and they are asked to sign in.

**Given** an unauthenticated visitor **When** they open the tournament list, a tournament's details, or browse facilities/courts/prices/available slots **Then** the content is shown without requiring sign-in. *(Provisional — see Decision #21.)*
review_note: AC còn ghi Provisional (Decision #21); chưa chốt quyền xem công khai.

text: **Given** a signed-in `PLAYER` or `COURT_OWNER` **When** they attempt to open or use any Admin platform-administration area **Then** access is refused, no administration data is shown, and they are told the area is not available to their account.
**Given** a signed-in `ADMIN` **When** they attempt to create a court booking, create a matchmaking request, or register for a tournament **Then** the action is refused.
**Given** Player A created tournament T and Player B did not **When** Player B attempts an Organizer action on T **Then** the action is refused.
**Given** Player A created tournament T **When** Player A attempts an Organizer action on T that the tournament rules allow in its current state **Then** the action is permitted.

**Given** a signed-in `ADMIN` and a tournament T created by any Player **When** the Admin attempts a tournament-management action on T that the tournament rules allow **Then** the action is permitted.

**Given** a database migrated and seeded per §17 **When** a visitor registers with valid input and then calls `GET /auth/me` with the returned cookies **Then** `200` returns the new account without a separate sign-in. *(Superseded by PRD Decision #28: registration sets no cookies; `GET /auth/me` is `401` until the Player signs in.)*
review_note: PRD Decision #28: đăng ký không đặt cookie; /auth/me là 401 đến khi đăng nhập.

text: **Given** an account locked after five failures **When** `AUTH_FAILED_LOGIN_LOCKOUT_MINUTES` passes and the user signs in with the correct password **Then** sign-in succeeds and `failed_attempts` is 0.

**Given** a signed-in user with `must_change_password = true` **When** they call any route other than `GET /auth/me` or `POST /auth/password/change` **Then** the response is `403 AUTH_PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED`, and after a successful password change the same route is allowed. Verification also requires:
The migrations in §17 apply cleanly to a copy of the current database.
Every error code in §9.3 is produced by at least one test.

text: A tournament opens only from a valid DRAFT; closing with at least 2 registrations yields REGISTRATION_CLOSED, with fewer it is CANCELLED with refunds; Organizer cancels only DRAFT/OPEN/CLOSED/READY; completion requires a resolved final.

Registration is accepted only in OPEN_FOR_REGISTRATION, inside the registration window, with a free slot, inside the skill range, by a Player other than the Organizer, with no duplicate entry; concurrent claims for the last slot admit exactly one.

The entry fee is debited from the payer wallet in the same transaction; insufficient balance creates no registration; withdrawal, Organizer removal and Organizer/Admin cancellation refund 100% exactly once; completion credits the Organizer exactly once and cancellation credits nothing.

A Doubles team has exactly two players, is created by a captain who invites and the invitee accepts; a Player belongs to at most one team per tournament; membership locks after team registration; pending invitations are cancelled when registration closes.

Bracket size is the smallest power of two at least the registration count; BYEs are allocated to high seeds; seeded positions follow the standard layout; the bracket and seed order lock after the draw.

Automatic scheduling places every match on virtual courts without court or participant overlap, respects minimum rest and feeder order, stays inside the daily window with overflow to the next day; manual time/court edits are allowed only before a match starts and conflicts are warnings.

Only the Organizer enters results; a set is valid only at 21 with a lead of 2, 22–30 with a lead of 2, or 30–29; a match is best of three; walkover/retirement advance the opponent; a final-winner correction is allowed within 48 hours and a non-final winner change is never allowed.
Organizer rights are contextual to the tournament the Player created; another Player is denied; Admin may cancel any non-terminal tournament but does not run it or enter results.

The tournament job closes registration at the deadline, cancels with refunds when fewer than 2 registered, completes 3 days after tournament_end when the final is resolved, and cancels with full refunds 14 days after tournament_end otherwise; repeated or concurrent runs are idempotent.
Tournament watchers receive an update within 1 second of a result change, only authorized watchers receive it, and a connection holds at most 5 watches.

After completion only the Organizer and the top four may share the result once to Social; the system group chat includes Organizer and participants minus blocked users, removes removed participants and locks on cancellation.

For a professional tournament the Organizer may set inclusive minimum/maximum skill levels; eligibility is checked at registration, team creation and invitation acceptance, and is not re-checked afterwards.

A professional tournament result updates the form score/level deterministically, ignores walkovers, produces a level change only when the threshold is crossed, replays a correction within 48 hours, and feeds the achievement leaderboard.

text: The finance ledger matches top-up/payment/refund/payout/adjustment source rows, each Admin credit/debit writes one ledger entry and one audit event and rejects over-balance, reconciliation detects discrepancy types, export is audited, and no response/log exposes provider secrets or full bank numbers.
VNPAY signing uses the documented sorted, encoded canonical query, verification rejects tampering, and dates are formatted in GMT+7.
Each committed domain event creates exactly one notification per intended recipient, never for the actor, with a stable deduplication key.
Notification rows are written in the caller transaction, roll back with the domain change, and concurrent retries of the same transition leave exactly one row.
The notification API lists only the caller rows newest-first, returns the exact unread count, marks read idempotently keeping the first read_at, and returns a non-enumerating 404 for another user id.
A notification detail adds a resource path only when the caller can access that resource at open time; hidden, deleted or foreign resources yield no path or 404.
Booking confirmation, Player cancellation, Owner incident cancellation, refund outcome, payout state and Owner earning each notify the correct recipient exactly once.
An Owner lists and edits only facilities with owner_id equal to the caller; another Owner gets a non-enumerating 404; an Owner submission is PENDING_APPROVAL and not bookable until Admin approval.
Pricing intervals cannot overlap; a price edit keeps existing booking snapshots and pricing detail; an interval without pricing is unavailable rather than free.
A maintenance block covers one range, is ACTIVE and excludes Player availability, rejects overlap with an effective booking, and releases one whole block idempotently.

Owner cancellation before start of a paid booking creates one refund intent and one Player notification; an unpaid hold is cancelled with no refund; a replay is idempotent; another Owner gets 404; started and tournament reservations are refused.
An opening-hours change is serialized with booking creation and cannot make an effective future or in-progress booking invalid.
Registration returns a pending challenge until the email OTP is verified; verification creates exactly one ACTIVE PLAYER with a profile and survey result and sets no session cookie.
A public registration request that supplies a role or another forbidden field is rejected and creates no COURT_OWNER/ADMIN account.
After the configured lockout interval passes, sign-in with the correct password succeeds and failed_attempts becomes 0.
An authenticated ADMIN cannot create a booking, matchmaking request or tournament registration.
Avatar upload accepts only JPEG/PNG/WebP within byte and decoded-pixel bounds, requires an active Player and CSRF, and keeps file and DB pointer consistent on replace or failure.
A phone number is optional, normalized and private, may be cleared by its owner, and cannot be changed by another user.
Free posts and match-finding posts are separate surfaces: the Social feed never returns a MATCH_FINDING post, while Matchmaking discovery does; reactions/comments never create membership.

The 16-item survey computes S from the six weighted groups, applies the returning penalty, rounds only for storage/display, compares unrounded values to the seven bands, and caps the final rank with G1 and G2.
A Player completes the survey once; no retake is offered and the result stays tied to the survey version taken.
Apply and Invite share one membership model; an out-of-range skill is a warning, not a block; a pending row reserves no time and expires no later than the start or recruitment close.

The host approves or rejects; only one of concurrent approvals can take the last seat; approval rechecks block and schedule and closes overlapping pending rows; the notification side effect is atomic.

A full roster is not a Match until the host confirms; Singles/Doubles need 2/4 accounts; GROUP needs its minimum and at least one accepted member besides the host; confirmation closes pending rows and creates one Match atomically.

Before the payment lock, withdrawal/removal releases a seat, reopens a full GROUP with the same Match, or cancels a full Singles/Doubles Match; the host cannot remove itself; after start or expiry the action is refused.

A linked booking must be paid, owned by the host, future, on the preferred date, inside the window, of the snapshotted duration and unlinked; otherwise linkage is refused. No court at start cancels with COURT_NOT_BOOKED; cancelling the booking cancels the Match.

A valid withdrawal or host removal revokes linked-group chat membership in the same transaction and blocks further REST/media/WebSocket access, without deleting old messages or affecting independent groups.

Every state-changing authenticated request requires the double-submit X-CSRF-Token to match the csrf_token cookie; a missing or mismatched token is rejected with the shared CSRF error and changes nothing.
A direct or group message reaches an online recipient over WebSocket within 2 seconds, and only an ACTIVE member can read history or attachments.
Message attachments accept only the documented image/document types and size/count limits, are stored privately, and are served only to an ACTIVE member.
Unread counts exclude the sender and left members, read markers are monotonic, per-message reactions are one per Player, and reply/edit/recall/hide follow the documented ownership rules.
